Strategy: Scale both the sweet-band reward and the mid penalty to eighteen, between the fifteen and twenty versions already tried. This tests the middle of the gentle steering range, but the smaller adjustments may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (18 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (18 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
